notes.title: An Update Regarding The Olivia Plush
notes.notes:
Hello all, The Olivia plushies have finally made it to the United States and are undergoing customs clearance. Once they're free from customs, they will be transported to our American factory for finishing, quality assurance, and finally distribution.



Since the delivery date is drawing closer, we're requesting that those who need to change their address for delivery do so now. This can be done using this form.



Further updates on the plush can be found by subscribing to our Plush Updates mailing list, which can be found at the bottom of our FAQ page.



We would also like to thank everyone for their patience during this process and apologize for the difficulty in making it happen quickly as we had hoped. We're doing what we can to get the product in your hands as fast as possible.

notes.title: I Wani Hug That Gator Release Date!
notes.notes:
I Wani Hug That Gator will release on February 14th! It will cost $14.99USD, and will have regional pricing adjustments as well.

A Spanish translation is already underway and will be ready sometime after launch!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
v1.1.0

    Added Android port.
    Added Spanish translation.
    Made various changes to the script.
    Replaced title screen music.
    Replaced game icons with higher-res versions.
    Updated Damien's front yard background.
    Updated Damien's living room background.
    Added a calligraphy CG when Olivia draws Inco in chapter 2.
    Overhauled Olivia's sprites to be segmented.
    Fixed shading in the pool dunking animation.
    Lowered the default view of the metro animation.
    Various small choreo tweaks.
    Music changes after Inco sits back down with Olivia in Iadakan's class in chapter 3.
    Added an easel prop when Inco and Olivia paint together in chapter 4.
    Drawing Game QOL changes:
        Drawing buttons are now smaller on PC.
        Added Ctrl Z support.
        Included an additional hint to hide the UI.
        When rolling back to the drawing game, there will be a skip button to prevent re-submitting a drawing.
